blocks.en: Abstract — Humanoid robots hold the potential for unparalleled versatility for performing human-like, whole-body skills. However, achieving agile and coordinated whole-body motions remains a significant challenge due to the dynamics mismatch between simulation and the real world. blocks.en: to train a delta (residual) action model that compensates for the dynamics mismatch. Then ASAP fine-tunes pre-trained policies with the delta action model integrated into the simulator to align effectively with real-world dynamics. We evaluate ASAP across three transfer scenarios—IsaacGym to IsaacSim, IsaacGym to Genesis, and IsaacGym to the real-world Unitree G1 humanoid robot. Our approach significantly improves agility and wholebody coordination across various dynamic motions, reducing tracking error compared to SysID, DR, and delta dynamics learning baselines. ASAP enables highly agile motions that were previously difficult to achieve, demonstrating the potential of delta action learning in bridging simulation and real-world dynamics. These results suggest a promising sim-to-real direction for developing more expressive and agile humanoids.
blocks.zh: 以训练一个用于补偿动力学失配的增量（残差）动作模型。接着，ASAP 将增量动作模型集成到仿真器中来微调预训练策略，从而有效地与现实世界的动力学对齐。我们在三种迁移场景中评估了 ASAP —— IsaacGym 到 IsaacSim、IsaacGym 到 Genesis，以及 IsaacGym 到真实的 Unitree G1 人形机器人。在各种高动态运动中，相比于 SysID、DR 和增量动力学学习等基线方法，我们的方法显著提高了敏捷性与全身协调性，并降低了跟踪误差。ASAP 实现了以往难以完成的高敏捷度动作，展示了增量动作学习在弥合仿真与现实动力学差距方面的潜力。这些结果为开发更具表现力且更敏捷的人形机器人指出了一条大有前景的仿真到现实迁移（sim-to-real）方向。

blocks.en: I. INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: I. 引言

blocks.en: For decades, we have envisioned humanoid robots achieving or even surpassing human-level agility. However, most prior work [46, 74, 47, 73, 107, 19, 95, 50] has primarily focused on locomotion, treating the legs as a means of mobility. Recent studies [10, 25, 24, 26, 32] have introduced wholebody expressiveness in humanoid robots, but these efforts have primarily focused on upper-body motions and have yet to achieve the agility seen in human movement. Achieving agile, whole-body skills in humanoid robots remains a fundamental challenge due to not only hardware limits but also the mismatch between simulated dynamics and real-world physics.
blocks.zh: 数十年来，我们一直憧憬人形机器人能够达到甚至超越人类水平的敏捷度。然而，先前的大多数工作 [46, 74, 47, 73, 107, 19, 95, 50] 主要聚焦于双足移动（locomotion），仅将双腿作为移动的手段。近期的研究 [10, 25, 24, 26, 32] 虽然引入了人形机器人的全身表现力，但这些工作主要集中在上半身动作，仍未能达到人类运动中所具备的敏捷性。由于不仅受到硬件限制，还面临仿真动力学与现实世界物理之间的失配，在人形机器人上实现敏捷的全身技能依然是一项根本性挑战。

blocks.en: Three main approaches have emerged to bridge the dynamics mismatch: System Identification (SysID) methods, domain randomization (DR), and learned dynamics methods. SysID methods directly estimate critical physical parameters, such as motor response characteristics, the mass of each robot link, and terrain properties [102, 19]. However, these methods require a pre-defined parameter space [49], which may not fully capture
blocks.zh: 为弥合动力学失配，目前已涌现出三种主要方法：系统辨识（SysID）方法、域随机化（DR）以及基于学习的动力学方法。SysID 方法直接估计关键物理参数，如电机响应特性、机器人各连杆的质量以及地形属性 [102, 19]。然而，这些方法需要预先定义参数空间 [49]，可能无法完全捕获

blocks.en: the sim-to-real gap, especially when real-world dynamics fall outside the modeled distribution. SysID also often relies on ground truth torque measurements [29], which are unavailable on many widely used hardware platforms, limiting its practical applicability. DR methods, in contrast, first train control policies in simulation before deploying them on real-world hardwares [85, 79, 59]. To mitigate the dynamics mismatch between simulation and real-world physics, DR methods rely on randomizing simulation parameters [87, 68]; but this can lead to overly conservative policies [25], ultimately hindering the development of highly agile skills. Another approach to bridge dynamics mismatch is learning a dynamics model of real-world physics using real-world data. While this approach has demonstrated success in low-dimensional systems such as drones [81] and ground vehicles [97], its effectiveness for humanoid robots remains unexplored.
blocks.zh: 仿真到现实的差距（sim-to-real gap），特别是当现实世界的动力学落在所建模的分布之外时。SysID 还常常依赖于真实的关节力矩测量真值 [29]，而在许多广泛使用的硬件平台上无法获取该数据，这限制了其实际适用性。相比之下，DR 方法首先在仿真中训练控制策略，然后将其部署到真实硬件上 [85, 79, 59]。为了缓解仿真与现实世界物理之间的动力学失配，DR 方法依赖于随机化仿真参数 [87, 68]；但这可能导致策略过于保守 [25]，最终阻碍高度敏捷技能的发展。弥合动力学失配的另一种方法是利用真实世界数据来学习现实世界物理的动力学模型。尽管该方法已在无人机 [81] 和地面车辆 [97] 等低维系统中取得了成功，但其在人形机器人上的有效性仍有待探索。

blocks.en: To this end, we propose ASAP, a two-stage framework that aligns the dynamics mismatch between simulation and realworld physics, enabling agile humanoid whole-body skills. ASAP involves a pre-training stage where we train base policies in simulation and a post-training stage that finetunes the policy by aligning simulation and real-world dynamics. In the pre-training stage, we train a motion tracking policy in simulation using human motion videos as data sources. These motions are first retargeted to humanoid robots [25], and a phase-conditioned motion tracking policy [67] is trained to follow the retargeted movements. However, directly deploying this policy on real hardware results in degraded performance due to the dynamics mismatch. To address this, the posttraining stage collects real-world rollout data, including proprioceptive states and positions recorded by the motion capture
blocks.zh: 为此，我们提出了 ASAP，这是一个用于对齐仿真与现实世界物理之间的动力学失配、从而实现敏捷人形机器人全身技能的两阶段框架。ASAP 包含一个在仿真中训练基础策略的预训练阶段，以及一个通过对齐仿真与现实世界动力学来微调策略的后训练阶段。在预训练阶段，我们以人体运动视频为数据源，在仿真中训练动作跟踪策略。这些动作首先被重定向到人形机器人上 [25]，并训练一个基于相位条件的动作跟踪策略 [67] 来跟踪重定向后的运动。然而，由于动力学失配，直接在真实硬件上部署该策略会导致性能下降。为了解决这个问题，后训练阶段会采集现实世界的 rollout 数据，包括本体感受状态以及由动作捕捉

blocks.en: system. The collected data are then replayed in simulation, where the dynamics mismatch manifests as tracking errors. We then train a delta action model that learns to compensate for these discrepancies by minimizing the difference between real-world and simulated states. This model effectively serves as a residual correction term for the dynamics gap. Finally, we fine-tune the pre-trained policy using the delta action model, allowing it to adapt effectively to real-world physics.
blocks.zh: 系统记录的位置。随后在仿真中重放采集到的数据，此时动力学失配会体现为跟踪误差。接着，我们训练一个增量动作模型，通过最小化现实世界状态与仿真状态之间的差异来学习补偿这些偏差。该模型实际上充当了动力学差距的残差修正项。最后，我们利用增量动作模型微调预训练策略，使其能够有效适应现实世界的物理特性。

blocks.en: We validate ASAP on diverse agile motions and successfully achieve whole-body agility on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot [77]. Our approach significantly reduces motion tracking error compared to prior SysID, DR, and delta dynamics learning baselines in both sim-to-sim (IsaacGym to IsaacSim, IsaacGym to Genesis) and sim-to-real (IsaacGym to Real) transfer scenarios. Our contributions are summarized below.
blocks.zh: 我们在多种敏捷动作上验证了 ASAP，并在 Unitree G1 人形机器人 [77] 上成功实现了全身敏捷性。在仿真到仿真（IsaacGym 到 IsaacSim、IsaacGym 到 Genesis）以及仿真到现实（IsaacGym 到真实世界）的迁移场景中，与以往的 SysID、DR 和增量动力学学习基线相比，我们的方法显著降低了动作跟踪误差。我们的贡献总结如下。

blocks.en: - 1) We introduce ASAP, a framework that bridges the simto-real gap by leveraging a delta action model trained via reinforcement learning (RL) with real-world data.
blocks.zh: - 1) 我们提出了 ASAP，这是一个利用在真实世界数据上通过强化学习（RL）训练的增量动作模型来弥合仿真到现实差距（sim-to-real gap）的框架。

blocks.en: - 2) We successfully deploy RL-based whole-body control policies in the real world, achieving previously difficultto-achieve humanoid motions.
blocks.zh: - 2) 我们成功在现实世界中部署了基于 RL 的全身控制策略，实现了以往难以完成的人形机器人动作。

blocks.en: - 3) Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that ASAP effectively reduces dynamics mismatch, enabling highly agile motions on robots and significantly reducing motion tracking errors.
blocks.zh: - 3) 在仿真和现实世界环境中的广泛实验表明，ASAP 能够有效减少动力学失配，使机器人能够完成高度敏捷的动作，并显著降低动作跟踪误差。

blocks.en: - 4) To facilitate smooth transfer between simulators, we develop and open-source a multi-simulator training and evaluation codebase for help accelerate further research.
blocks.zh: - 4) 为促进不同仿真器之间的顺畅迁移，我们开发并开源了一个多仿真器训练与评估代码库，以助力加速后续研究。

blocks.en: II. PRE-TRAINING: LEARNING AGILE HUMANOID SKILLS
blocks.zh: II. 预训练：学习敏捷人形机器人技能

blocks.en: A. Data Generation: Retargeting Human Video Data
blocks.zh: A. 数据生成：重定向人类视频数据

blocks.en: To track expressive and agile motions, we collect a video dataset of human movements and retarget it to robot motions, creating imitation goals for motion-tracking policies, as shown in Figure 3 and Figure 2 (a).
blocks.zh: 为了跟踪富有表现力且敏捷的动作，我们采集了一个人类运动视频数据集，并将其重定向为机器人动作，从而为动作跟踪策略构建模仿目标，如图 3 和图 2 (a) 所示。

blocks.en: a) Transforming Human Video to SMPL Motions: We begin by recording videos (see Figure 3 (a) and Figure 12) of humans performing expressive and agile motions. Using TRAM [93], we reconstruct 3D motions from videos. TRAM estimates the global trajectory of the human motions in SMPL parameter format [52], which includes global root translation, orientation, body poses, and shape parameters, as shown in Figure 3 (b). The resulting motions are denoted as D SMPL.
blocks.zh: a) 将人类视频转换为 SMPL 动作：我们首先录制人类执行富有表现力且敏捷动作的视频（参见图 3 (a) 和图 12）。使用 TRAM [93]，我们从视频中重建 3D 动作。TRAM 以 SMPL 参数格式 [52] 估计人体运动的全局轨迹，包括全局根节点平移、朝向、身体姿态和体型参数，如图 3 (b) 所示。生成的动作表示为 D SMPL。

blocks.en: b) Simulation-based Data Cleaning: Since the reconstruction process can introduce noise and errors [25], some estimated motions may not be physically feasible, making them unsuitable for motion tracking in the real world. To address this, we employ a “sim-to-data” cleaning procedure. Specifically, we use MaskedMimic [86], a physics-based motion tracker, to imitate the SMPL motions from TRAM in IsaacGym simulator [58]. The motions (Figure 3 (c)) that pass this simulation-based validation are saved as the cleaned dataset D SMPLCleaned.
blocks.zh: b) 基于仿真的数据清洗：由于重建过程可能会引入噪声和误差 [25]，部分估计出的动作在物理上可能不可行，因而不适于在现实世界中进行动作跟踪。为了解决这一问题，我们采用了一种“仿真到数据（sim-to-data）”的清洗流程。具体而言，我们在 IsaacGym 仿真器 [58] 中使用基于物理的动作跟踪器 MaskedMimic [86] 来模仿来自 TRAM 的 SMPL 动作。通过该基于仿真的验证的动作（图 3 (c)）被保存为清洗后的数据集 D SMPLCleaned。

blocks.en: c) Retargeting SMPL Motions to Robot Motions: With the cleaned dataset D SMPLCleaned in SMPL format, we retarget the motions into robot motions following the shape-and-motion two-stage retargeting process [25]. Since the SMPL parameters estimated by TRAM represent various human body shapes, we first optimize the shape parameter β′ to approximate a humanoid shape. By selecting 12 body links with correspondences between humans and humanoids, we perform gradient descent on β′ to minimize joint distances in the rest pose. Using the optimized shape β′ along with the original translation p and pose θ , we apply gradient descent to further minimize the distances of the body links. This process ensures accurate motion retargeting and produces the cleaned robot trajectory dataset D RobotCleaned,asshowninFigure3(d).
blocks.zh: c) 将 SMPL 动作重定向为机器人动作：在获得 SMPL 格式的清洗数据集 D SMPLCleaned 后，我们遵循形状与动作两阶段重定向流程 [25] 将动作重定向为机器人动作。由于 TRAM 估计的 SMPL 参数代表多样的人体体型，我们首先优化体型参数 β′ 以逼近人形机器人的形态。通过选取人体与人形机器人之间具有对应关系的 12 个身体连杆，我们对 β′ 执行梯度下降以最小化静态姿势（rest pose）下的关节距离。利用优化后的体型 β′ 以及原始平移 p 和姿态 θ，我们应用梯度下降进一步最小化身体连杆的距离。该过程确保了精准的动作重定向，并生成了清洗后的机器人轨迹数据集 D RobotCleaned，如图 3 (d) 所示。

blocks.en: a) Asymmetric Actor-Critic Training: Real-world humanoid control is inherently a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), where certain task-relevant properties that are readily available in simulation become unobservable in real-world scenarios. However, these missing properties can significantly facilitate policy training in simulation. To bridge this gap, we employ an asymmetric actorcritic framework, where the critic network has access to privileged information such as the global positions of the reference motion and the root linear velocity, while the actor network relies solely on proprioceptive inputs and a time-phase variable. This design not only enhances phase-based motion tracking during training but also enables a simple, phasedriven motion goal for sim-to-real transfer. Crucially, because the actor does not depend on position-based motion targets, our approach eliminates the need for odometry during realworld deployment—overcoming a well-documented challenge in prior work on humanoid robots [25, 24].
blocks.zh: a) 非对称 Actor-Critic 训练：现实世界中的人形机器人控制本质上是一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），在仿真中唾手可得的某些任务相关属性在现实世界场景中变得不可观测。然而，这些缺失的属性能够显著促进仿真中的策略训练。为了弥合这一差距，我们采用非对称 Actor-Critic 框架，其中 Critic 网络可以访问诸如参考运动的全局位置和根节点线速度等特权信息，而 Actor 网络仅依赖本体感受输入和时间相位变量。这种设计不仅增强了训练期间基于相位的动作跟踪能力，还为仿真到现实迁移（sim-to-real）提供了一个简单且由相位驱动的运动目标。至关重要的是，由于 Actor 不依赖于基于位置的运动目标，我们的方法在现实世界部署时无需里程计（odometry）——从而克服了以往人形机器人研究中备受困扰的一大挑战 [25, 24]。

blocks.en: b) Termination Curriculum of Tracking Tolerance: Training a policy to track agile motions in simulation is challenging, as certain motions can be too difficult for the policy to learn effectively. For instance, when imitating a jumping motion, the policy often fails early in training and learns to remain on the ground to avoid landing penalties. To mitigate this issue, we introduce a termination curriculum that progressively refines the motion error tolerance throughout training, guiding the policy toward improved tracking performance. Initially, we set a generous termination threshold of 1.5m, meaning the episode terminates if the robot deviates from the reference motion by this margin. As training progresses, we gradually tighten this threshold to 0.3m, incrementally increasing the tracking demand on the policy. This curriculum allows the policy to first develop basic balancing skills before progressively enforcing stricter motion tracking, ultimately enabling successful execution of high-dynamic behaviors.
blocks.zh: b) 跟踪容差的终止课程（Termination Curriculum）：在仿真中训练策略以跟踪敏捷动作极具挑战性，因为某些动作对于策略而言可能过于困难而难以有效学习。例如，在模仿跳跃动作时，策略在训练早期往往会失败，并学会停留在地面上以避免受到着陆惩罚。为了缓解这一问题，我们引入了终止课程，在整个训练过程中逐步收紧动作误差容差，从而引导策略提升跟踪性能。最初，我们设定了一个较为宽松的 1.5m 终止阈值，意味着如果机器人偏离参考动作达到该幅度，该 episode 即告终止。随着训练的推进，我们逐渐将该阈值收紧至 0.3m，逐步提高对策略的跟踪要求。这种课程设计使策略能够先掌握基本的平衡技能，随后逐步执行更严格的动作跟踪，最终成功实现高动态行为的执行。

blocks.en: c) Reference State Initialization: Task initialization plays a crucial role in RL training. We find that naively initializing episodes at the start of the reference motion leads to policy failure. For example, in Cristiano Ronaldo’s jumping training, starting the episode from the beginning forces the policy to learn sequentially. However, a successful backflip requires mastering the landing first—if the policy cannot land correctly, it will struggle to complete the full motion from takeoff. To address this, we adopt the Reference State Initialization (RSI) framework [67]. Specifically, we randomly sample timephase variables between 0 and 1, which effectively randomizes the starting point of the reference motion for the policy to track. We then initialize the robot’s state based on the corresponding reference motion at that phase, including root position and orientation, root linear and angular velocities
blocks.zh: c) 参考状态初始化：任务初始化在强化学习（RL）训练中起着至关重要的作用。我们发现，若单纯在参考动作的起始处初始化回合（episode），会导致策略训练失败。例如，在克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多（Cristiano Ronaldo）的跳跃动作训练中，从起始点开始回合会迫使策略按时序依次学习。然而，成功完成后空翻需要先掌握着陆——如果策略无法正确着陆，就很难从起跳开始完成整个动作。为此，我们采用了参考状态初始化（RSI）框架 [67]。具体而言，我们在 0 到 1 之间随机采样时间相位变量，从而有效地将策略所需跟踪的参考动作起点随机化。然后，我们根据该相位对应的参考动作来初始化机器人的状态，包括根部位置与朝向、根部线速度与角速度

blocks.en: and joint positions and velocities. blocks.en: By learning the delta action model, the simulator can accurately reproduce real-world failures. For example, consider a scenario where the simulated robot can jump because its motor strength is overestimated, but the real-world robot cannot jump due to weaker motors. blocks.en: To address Q2 ( Can ASAP finetune policy to outperform SysID and Delta Dynamics methods? ), we evaluate the effectiveness of different methods in fine-tuning RL policies for improved testing-environment performance. As shown in Table IV, ASAP consistently outperforms baselines such as Vanilla, SysID, and DeltaDynamics across all difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, and Hard) in both simulators (IsaacSim and Genesis). For the Easy level, our method achieves the lowest E g-mpjpe and E mpjpe in IsaacSim ( E g-mpjpe = 106 and E mpjpe = 44 . 3) and Genesis ( E g-mpjpe = 125 and E mpjpe = 73 . 5), with minimal acceleration (Eacc) and velocity (Evel) errors. Given these constraints, we adopt a more sample-efficient approach by focusing exclusively on learning a 4-DoF ankle delta action model rather than the full-body 23-DoF model. This decision is motivated by two key factors: (1) the limited availability of real-world data makes training the full 23-DoF delta action model infeasible, and (2) the Unitree G1 robot [77] features a mechanical linkage design in the ankle, which introduces a significant sim-to-real gap that is difficult to bridge with conventional modeling techniques [37]. Under this setting, the original 23 DoF delta action model reduces to 4 DoF delta action model, which needs much less data to be trainable. In practice, we collect 100 motion clips, which prove sufficient to train an effective 4-DoF delta action model for real-world scenarios.

blocks.en: VI. RELATED WORKS
blocks.zh: VI. 相关工作

blocks.en: A. Learning-based Methods for Humanoid Control
blocks.zh: A. 用于人形机器人控制的基于学习的方法

blocks.en: In recent years, learning-based methods have made significant progress in whole-body control for humanoid robots. Primarily leveraging reinforcement learning algorithms [80] within physics simulators [58, 63, 88], humanoid robots have learned a wide range of skills, including robust locomo-
blocks.zh: 近年来，基于学习的方法在人形机器人全身控制方面取得了重大进展。主要通过在物理仿真器 [58, 63, 88] 中利用强化学习算法 [80]，人形机器人已经学会了广泛的技能，包括鲁棒的运动

blocks.en: tion [44, 98, 45, 48, 47, 74, 73, 19, 106], jumping [46], and parkour [50, 107]. More advanced capabilities, such as dancing [105, 32, 10], loco-manipulation [25, 53, 15, 24], and even backflipping [78], have also been demonstrated. Meanwhile, the humanoid character animation community has achieved highly expressive and agile whole-body motions in physicsbased simulations [71, 86, 55], including cartwheels [67], backflips [69], sports movements [104, 90, 56, 91, 92], and smooth object interactions [86, 17, 22]. However, transferring these highly dynamic and agile skills to real-world humanoid robots remains challenging due to the dynamics mismatch between simulation and real-world physics. To address this challenge, our work focuses on learning and compensating for this dynamics mismatch, enabling humanoid robots to perform expressive and agile whole-body skills in the real world.
blocks.zh: 能力（locomotion）[44, 98, 45, 48, 47, 74, 73, 19, 106]、跳跃 [46] 以及跑酷 [50, 107]。更高级的能力，例如舞蹈 [105, 32, 10]、移动操作（loco-manipulation）[25, 53, 15, 24] 甚至后空翻 [78]，也已得到展示。与此同时，人形角色动画领域在基于物理的仿真中实现了极具表现力且敏捷的全身动作 [71, 86, 55]，包括侧手翻 [67]、后空翻 [69]、体育运动动作 [104, 90, 56, 91, 92] 以及平滑的物体交互 [86, 17, 22]。然而，由于仿真与真实世界物理之间的动力学失配，将这些高动态且敏捷的技能迁移至真实世界的人形机器人仍具有挑战性。为了应对这一挑战，我们的工作重点在于学习并补偿这种动力学失配，从而使人形机器人能够在真实世界中执行极具表现力且敏捷的全身技能。

blocks.en: B. Offline and Online System Identification for Robotics
blocks.zh: B. 用于机器人学的离线与在线系统辨识

blocks.en: The dynamics mismatch between simulators and real-world physics can be attributed to two primary factors: inaccuracies in the robot model descriptions and the presence of complex real-world dynamics that are difficult for physics-based simulators to capture. Traditional approaches address these issues using system identification (SysID) methods [39, 5], which calibrate the robot model or simulator based on real-world performance. These methods can be broadly categorized into offline SysID and online SysID , depending on whether system identification occurs at test time. Offline SysID methods typically collect real-world data and adjust simulation parameters to train policies in more accurate dynamics. The calibration process may focus on modeling actuator dynamics [85, 29, 99], refining robot dynamics models [36, 2, 18, 21, 30], explicitly identifying critical simulation parameters [102, 9, 13, 96], learning a distribution over simulation parameters [75, 27, 4], or optimizing system parameters to maximize policy performance [64, 76]. Online SysID methods, in contrast, aim to learn a representation of the robot’s state or environment properties, enabling real-time adaptation to different conditions. These representations can be learned using optimizationbased approaches [101, 103, 43, 70], regression-based methods [100, 40, 89, 19, 31, 60, 14, 72, 61, 41, 62, 42], next-state reconstruction techniques [65, 51, 54, 94, 83], direct reward maximization [47], or by leveraging tracking and prediction errors for online adaptation [66, 57, 28, 16]. Our framework takes a different approach from traditional SysID methods by learning a residual action model that directly compensates for dynamics mismatch through corrective actions, rather than explicitly estimating system parameters.
blocks.zh: 仿真器与真实世界物理之间的动力学失配可归因于两个主要因素：机器人模型描述的不准确性，以及基于物理的仿真器难以捕捉的复杂真实世界动力学的存在。传统方法使用系统辨识（SysID）方法 [39, 5] 来解决这些问题，这类方法基于真实世界的表现来校准机器人模型或仿真器。根据系统辨识是否发生在测试时，这些方法大致可分为离线 SysID 和在线 SysID。离线 SysID 方法通常收集真实世界数据并调整仿真参数，以便在更准确的动力学环境中训练策略。校准过程可能侧重于建模执行器动力学 [85, 29, 99]、精细化机器人动力学模型 [36, 2, 18, 21, 30]、显式辨识关键仿真参数 [102, 9, 13, 96]、学习仿真参数上的分布 [75, 27, 4]，或优化系统参数以最大化策略性能 [64, 76]。相比之下，在线 SysID 方法旨在学习机器人状态或环境特性的表征，从而能够实时自适应于不同工况。这些表征可以通过基于优化的方法 [101, 103, 43, 70]、基于回归的方法 [100, 40, 89, 19, 31, 60, 14, 72, 61, 41, 62, 42]、下一状态重构技术 [65, 51, 54, 94, 83]、直接奖励最大化 [47]，或利用跟踪与预测误差进行在线自适应 [66, 57, 28, 16] 来学习。我们的框架采取了与传统 SysID 方法不同的途径，通过学习一个残差动作模型，以修正动作直接补偿动力学失配，而不是显式估计系统参数。

blocks.en: C. Residual Learning for Robotics
blocks.zh: C. 用于机器人学的残差学习

blocks.en: Learning a residual component alongside learned or predefined base models has been widely used in robotics. Prior work has explored residual policy models that refine the actions of an initial controller [84, 34, 8, 1, 12, 20, 3, 33, 42]. Other approaches leverage residual components to correct inaccuracies in dynamics models [66, 35, 38, 82, 23] or to model residual trajectories resulting from residual actions [11]
blocks.zh: 在已学习或预定义的基础模型之外同时学习残差分量，在机器人学中已得到广泛应用。先前的工作探索了改进初始控制器动作的残差策略模型 [84, 34, 8, 1, 12, 20, 3, 33, 42]。其他方法则利用残差分量来修正动力学模型中的不准确性 [66, 35, 38, 82, 23]，或对残差动作产生的残差轨迹进行建模 [11]

blocks.en: for achieving precise and agile motions. RGAT [35] uses a residual action model with a learned forward dynamics to refine the simulator. Our framework builds on this idea by using RL-based residual actions to align the dynamics mismatch between simulation and real-world physics, enabling agile whole-body humanoid skills.
blocks.zh: 以实现精确而敏捷的运动。RGAT [35] 使用带有已学习前向动力学的残差动作模型来精炼仿真器。我们的框架基于这一思想，利用基于强化学习的残差动作来对齐仿真与真实世界物理之间的动力学失配，从而赋能敏捷的人形机器人全身技能。

blocks.en: VII. CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: VII. 结论

blocks.en: We present ASAP, a two-stage framework that bridges the sim-to-real gap for agile humanoid control. By learning a universal delta action model to capture dynamics mismatch, ASAP enables policies trained in simulation to adapt seamlessly to real-world physics. Extensive experiments demonstrate significant reductions in motion tracking errors (up to 52.7% in sim-to-real tasks) and successful deployment of diverse agile skills—including agile jumps and kicks—on the Unitree G1 humanoid. Our work advances the frontier of simto-real transfer for agile whole-body control, paving the way for versatile humanoid robots in real-world applications.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了 ASAP，这是一个为敏捷人形机器人控制弥合仿真到现实差距的两阶段框架。通过学习通用 delta 动作模型来捕捉动力学失配，ASAP 使在仿真中训练的策略能够无缝自适应于真实世界物理。大量实验表明，运动跟踪误差显著降低（在仿真到现实任务中降幅高达 52.7%），并在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上成功部署了多样化的敏捷技能——包括敏捷跳跃和踢腿。我们的工作推进了敏捷全身控制仿真到现实迁移的前沿，为通用人形机器人在真实世界中的应用铺平了道路。

blocks.en: VIII. LIMITATIONS
blocks.zh: VIII. 局限性

blocks.en: While ASAP demonstrates promising results in bridging the sim-to-real gap for agile humanoid control, our framework has several real-world limitations that highlights critical challenges in scaling agile humanoid control to real-world:
blocks.zh: 尽管 ASAP 在弥合敏捷人形机器人控制的仿真到现实差距方面展现出极具前景的成果，但我们的框架仍存在若干真实世界的局限性，凸显了将敏捷人形机器人控制规模化推广至真实世界所面临的关键挑战：

blocks.en: - Hardware Constraints : Agile whole-body motions exert significant stress on robots, leading to motor overheating and hardware failure during data collection. Two Unitree G1 robots were broken to some extent during our experiments. This bottleneck limits the scale and diversity of real-world motion sequences that can be safely collected.
blocks.zh: - 硬件限制（Hardware Constraints）：敏捷的全身运动会对机器人产生巨大负荷，导致在数据采集过程中出现电机过热和硬件故障。在我们的实验中，两台 Unitree G1 机器人均受到了不同程度的损坏。这一瓶颈限制了能够安全采集的真实世界动作序列的规模和多样性。

blocks.en: - Dependence on Motion Capture Systems : Our pipeline requires MoCap setup to record real-world trajectories. This introduces practical deployment barriers in unstructured environments where MoCap setups are unavailable.
blocks.zh: - 对动捕系统的依赖（Dependence on Motion Capture Systems）：我们的流程需要动捕（MoCap）系统来记录真实世界的轨迹。这在无法使用动捕系统的非结构化环境中带来了实际部署障碍。

blocks.en: - Data-Hungry Delta Action Training : While reducing the delta action model to 4 DoF ankle joints improved sample efficiency, training the full 23 DoF model remains impractical for real-world deployment due to the large demand of required motion clips (e.g., > 400 episodes in simulation for the 23 DoF delta action training).
blocks.zh: - Delta 动作训练的数据需求量大（Data-Hungry Delta Action Training）：尽管将 delta 动作模型缩减至 4 个自由度（DoF）的踝关节提高了样本效率，但由于对所需动作片段的巨大需求（例如，在仿真中进行 23 个自由度的 delta 动作训练需要 > 400 个回合），训练完整的 23 个自由度模型对于真实世界部署而言仍不切实际。

blocks.en: Future directions could focus on developing damage-aware policy to mitigate hardware risks, leveraging MoCap-free alignment to eliminate the reliance on MoCap, and exploring adaptation techniques for delta action models to achieve sample-efficient few-shot alignment.
blocks.zh: 未来的研究方向可以着眼于开发具备损伤感知能力的策略以减轻硬件风险、利用无动捕（MoCap-free）对齐来消除对动捕的依赖，以及探索 delta 动作模型的自适应技术以实现高样本效率的小样本（few-shot）对齐。
